page_title: TOT 2-3 ARS | Tottenham Hotspur v Arsenal 28/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+7' Giovani Lo Celso (Tottenham) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
90+6' Tottenham take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+6' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. It will be a corner kick for Tottenham.
90+5' Giovani Lo Celso (Tottenham) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
90+4' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Tottenham, is intercepted by one of the defenders. Now Tottenham have a corner.

90+2' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Michael Oliver has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Arsenal have a free kick from a promising distance.
90+2' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) sends a teasing cross into the area, but David Raya intercepts the ball.
90+1' A player from Arsenal commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
90+1' Declan Rice (Arsenal) prepares to take a corner kick.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) takes the corner which is cleared. Corner kick. Arsenal will have an opportunity.
89' Mikel Arteta decides to make a substitution. Martin Odegaard will be replaced by Jakub Kiwior (Arsenal).
88' The substitution has been made. Giovani Lo Celso (Tottenham) has replaced Ben Davies.
87' 2 - 3 Goal! Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) puts the ball into the top left corner past the outstretched arm of David Raya.
86' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
85' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!
85' There's a break in play and referee Michael Oliver must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Tottenham using VAR. This could be interesting!
84' Ben Davies (Tottenham) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
83' Thomas Partey (Arsenal) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
82' Arsenal couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Guglielmo Vicario (Tottenham) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
81' Ben Davies (Tottenham) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
80' Michael Oliver has a clear sight and sees a foul from Ben Davies (Tottenham).
80' Kai Havertz received a clever long ball from David Raya (Arsenal) which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert and managed to avert the threat.
77' What was Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
77' The free kick is taken by Pedro Porro (Tottenham), but ball is cleared.

76' Takehiro Tomiyasu (Arsenal) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Michael Oliver no option but to blow his whistle. Tottenham are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
76' William Saliba (Arsenal) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Michael Oliver who sees an offensive foul.
75' Richarlison (Tottenham) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
74' David Raya (Arsenal) plays an extraordinary diagonal pass and Gabriel Martinelli darts into free space to control the ball.
73' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) smashes the ball upfield and Pedro Porro brings it down with a fine first touch.
72' Richarlison (Tottenham) sends a cross into the box, but David Raya comes off his line to gather the ball.
72' Takehiro Tomiyasu (Arsenal) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
71' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) tries to find Richarlison, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
69' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Arsenal.
68' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
67' A defence splitting pass into the box is almost received by Richarlison (Tottenham), but David Raya is quick enough and comes off his line to intercept the pass.
67' The foul by Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) was seen by Michael Oliver who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
66' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
64' 1 - 3 GOAL! Keeper David Raya totally miss kicks the ball straight to Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham), who slams the ball into the net from mid range. It’s now 1:3.
64' Substitution. James Maddison will be replaced by Richarlison (Tottenham).
64' Here is a change. Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg is going off and Ange Postecoglou gives the last tactical orders to Yves Bissouma (Tottenham).
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) comes onto the pitch for Leandro Trossard.
62' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
62' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is out of play. Arsenal will have a chance to score from a corner.
62' The Arsenal players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
60' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) finds himself in a promising position after receiving an excellent pass into the box, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention to avert the threat.
59' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Kai Havertz, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
58' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) is penalised for a foul. Michael Oliver had a clear view and blows his whistle.
57' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
56' James Maddison (Tottenham) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
56' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee points to the corner flag and Tottenham will take a corner.
54' The resulting set piece from Arsenal is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

53' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) races onto a cross inside the box and lets fly with a powerful effort, but Guglielmo Vicario makes a fantastic reaction save to deny him. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Arsenal.
52' PENALTY APPEAL after Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
51' Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) lets fly with a crisp shot from inside the box after picking up a lofted pass from Dejan Kulusevski, but the ball goes just over the bar.
50' The game is interrupted. Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.

49' What a chance that is! Takehiro Tomiyasu (Arsenal) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick, but he steers his header narrowly over the crossbar.
48' Declan Rice (Arsenal) looks like he will send a long ball into the penalty box from the free kick and it is a good chance for one of his teammates who is good in the air to get on the scoresheet.
47' Michael Oliver blows the whistle, Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Tottenham) is penalised for a foul.
46' Ange Postecoglou has made a change at the break. Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) has come on in place of Rodrigo Bentancur.
46' Referee Michael Oliver blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+7' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+6' James Maddison (Tottenham) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
45+6' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
45+6' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Tottenham.
45+5' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. Tottenham have been awarded a corner kick.
45+4' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
45+3' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
45+1' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
45+1' Thomas Partey (Arsenal) was too forceful with his tackle and Michael Oliver interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
45' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
45' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
44' Good clearance! James Maddison (Tottenham) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him.
43' 71:29 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
41' Tottenham hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
38' 0 - 3 Kai Havertz (Arsenal) converts the resulting corner kick with a precise header! He jumped highest to meet the ball and powers the ball behind the keeper into the net.
37' Arsenal get a corner.
36' Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
36' Handball by Kai Havertz (Arsenal).
35' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Tottenham) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
34' Arsenal are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
31' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
31' Ange Postecoglou is forced to make a change. Timo Werner is unable to continue due to injury, Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) comes on.
31' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
31' Timo Werner (Tottenham) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
30' Tottenham failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

29' Timo Werner (Tottenham) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. The linesman makes the right call and Tottenham will have a corner.
27' 0 - 2 Goal! Kai Havertz shows great vision to find Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the bottom left corner. 0:2.
26' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Tottenham for a penalty. Play continues.
25' The goal by Tottenham is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
23' Wait! Referee Michael Oliver has indicated he is going to review the Tottenham goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.

22' After a goalmouth scramble Micky van de Ven (Tottenham) wins the ball and unleashes a powerful and precise effort into the back of the net, beating the helpless goalkeeper. A wonderful football moment.
22' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) gets to the rebound outside the box and doesn't hesitate to shoot on goal. It was a promising attempt, but one of the defending players got in the way and blocked it.
22' James Maddison (Tottenham) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
22' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.

21' Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) wasted a great chance as he climbed high to connect with a cross from the free kick inside the penalty area. He planted a header against the bar and it glanced away off it.
21' James Maddison (Tottenham) will take a free kick. Is he going to strike the ball directly at the goal? Let's find out!
20' Dangerous play by Ben White (Arsenal). Michael Oliver blows his whistle for a foul.
18' James Maddison (Tottenham) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

15' 0 - 1 Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Tottenham) attempts to head the ball away from inside the six-yard box, but unluckily he turns a cross from the resulting corner into the top right corner of his own net.
15' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
15' Declan Rice (Arsenal) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
13' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Kai Havertz (Arsenal) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
12' Heung-Min Son picks out James Maddison (Tottenham) unmarked inside the box, but he blazes the ball well over the bar.
11' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) attempts to curl the ball over the defensive wall from the free kick, but his effort fails to reach the goal.
10' James Maddison (Tottenham) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Michael Oliver saw the whole situation. A free kick to Arsenal.
10' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
8' Timo Werner (Tottenham) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to David Raya, who smothers the ball.
6' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
5' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Tottenham) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
4' Ben White (Arsenal) passes the ball onto Bukayo Saka, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
3' Good defending. Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) tries to find Bukayo Saka inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
2' Takehiro Tomiyasu (Arsenal) commits a foul and Michael Oliver immediately signals a free kick.
1' Timo Werner (Tottenham) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Tottenham will have the kick-off.
Michael Oliver will officiate today.
